name: login-html
description: REGRESSION LOCK for the decode-before-status abort. A proxy in front of XIQ can answer the login POST with a 200 whose body is an HTML page (or an empty body); json_decode has no recoverable failure mode in Starlark, and the old code decoded the body before looking at anything else, so the task aborted with a decode error instead of a clean auth message. post_json surfaces the non-JSON 200 as an error string; the run must end with one request, zero assets, and a readable log line.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR. A primary response the script cannot read means no inventory, which is not an empty one.

log_contains: extreme-cloud-iq: login failed: status 200: invalid JSON response
